suggestions.title: Pass stored MergeSha when resuming upstream completion
suggestions.rationale: The Pipeline And Worker Lifecycle UAT plan expects an item resumed from Merged with MergeSha already present to pass that stored SHA to upstream completion. A focused UAT exercise showed PipelineRunner completes the upstream phase with UpstreamCompletionRequest.MergeSha set to null in this path, because the local mergeSha variable is only populated during the merge phase in the current process. This can deprive upstream remotes of the durable merge commit SHA after restart.
